name: AsmetaSEnforcerGuard
description: Formal Guard Enforcer wrapping the AsmetaS execution runtime for runtime verification and action sanitisation.

skills.name: list_models
skills.description: Retrieves the list of available ASM models and libraries loaded on the AsmetaS server.

skills.name: delete_model
skills.description: Deletes an ASM model from the AsmetaS runtime server.

asm_name.description: Name of the ASM model to delete.

skills.name: start_enforcer
skills.description: Initialises an AsmetaS formal guard execution session for a given ASM specification.

asm_name.description: The name of the ASM model file to start.

skills.name: sanitise_action
skills.description: Evaluates monitored variables and proposed input action against ASM formal rules, returning an APPROVED or VIOLATION verdict along with a sanitised action.

monitored_variables.description: Dictionary containing inputAction and environment state variables.

inputAction.description: The proposed action to be evaluated.

skills.name: stop_enforcer
skills.description: Stops the current active AsmetaS enforcer instance and clears state.
